text: As I enter this space, I am struck by the clinical clarity of glass and white walls—the environment is modern, almost antiseptic, yet I feel anticipation. There is a sense of purpose here. Moving further in, the bold colors and display labeled R+D ignite a spark of curiosity. I am surrounded by the energy of innovation and inquiry. The room invites contemplation about progress, collaboration, and the ever-shifting boundaries between human and machine. I am simultaneously small, humbled by human ambition, and inspired by collective ingenuity. Here, I feel a yearning to understand, to question, to participate in the unfolding story of human curiosity and discovery.
